svg.data-success-path: CoordinatorTeamRegistry.configure_for_delivery → TEAM_UPDATE → WorkerTeamState.install → delivery_snapshot → WorkerPeerSenderService.send_mail → direct Worker→Worker A2A → EnvelopeIngress authorization → EnvelopeAwareAdapter._handle_mail → WorkerMailboxStore.deliver → updater.complete → recipient terminal ACK → unread → ReadMailboxTool → mailbox summary → Worker Context Memory
svg.data-no-bypass: accepted MAIL must enter durable mailbox-delivery before read-context; no Ingress-to-Read/context connector
svg.title: Peer Mail lifecycle — direct worker-to-worker delivery through a durable mailbox
svg.desc: Source-grounded single-page lifecycle. The coordinator configures and revokes the roster but is not a MAIL relay. A worker takes an atomic delivery snapshot, sends a signed MAIL directly to the recipient worker, ingress verifies and authorizes it, EnvelopeAwareAdapter handles it through WorkerMailboxStore.deliver, the recipient completes the task for a terminal ACK, and the durable unread record is later read and surfaced through mailbox summary and Worker Context Memory. Rejections are terminal and consolidated.
